tools.name: bridge_get_started
tools.description: Step-by-step plan to add the official WhatsApp Business API to the user's own CRM/SaaS with WasapFlow Bridge: account, card, keys, webhook, Connect WhatsApp button, first message. Call this first when someone wants to build or connect WhatsApp. No partner key needed.

tools.name: bridge_docs_search
tools.description: Search the WasapFlow Bridge API reference, partner guide and changelog. Returns matching sections with a preview. Use before writing integration code. No partner key needed.

tools.name: bridge_docs_section
tools.description: Return the full text of one section (with its sub-sections) of the WasapFlow Bridge docs, e.g. "Verify Incoming Webhooks", "Send Template Message", "Webhook Event Payloads", "Error Codes". No partner key needed.

tools.name: bridge_list_numbers
tools.description: List the WhatsApp Business Accounts (client numbers) registered to this partner, with status.

tools.name: bridge_number_status
tools.description: Live status of a number from Meta: verified name, quality rating, messaging limit, name status.

tools.name: bridge_connect_link
tools.description: Create a short-lived (30 min) link that a business opens to connect its WhatsApp number through Meta Embedded Signup (Coexistence supported). Share the returned connect_url with the business owner.

tools.name: bridge_send_text
tools.description: Send a text message from a connected number. Free-form text only reaches people who messaged that number in the last 24 hours; otherwise use bridge_send_template. This sends a real message.

tools.name: bridge_send_template
tools.description: Send an approved template (works outside the 24-hour window). components follows the Meta Cloud API format. This sends a real message and Meta may charge for it.

tools.name: bridge_list_templates
tools.description: List the message templates of a number with their approval status.

tools.name: bridge_failed_webhooks
tools.description: Webhook events Bridge could not deliver to your webhook URL (with the error). Use when incoming messages are missing in the CRM.

tools.name: bridge_retry_webhooks
tools.description: Redeliver one failed webhook event (event_id) or all of them (omit event_id) after the webhook endpoint is fixed.

tools.name: bridge_usage
tools.description: Current Bridge plan: active WhatsApp numbers, slots and the monthly Bridge fee.

tools.name: bridge_open_ticket
tools.description: Open a WasapFlow support ticket. Include what happened, when (with timezone), the exact error (Meta code, fbtrace_id), what was tried and the business impact.

tools.name: bridge_list_tickets
tools.description: List support tickets and replies status.

tools.name: bridge_call_api
tools.description: Call any WasapFlow Bridge endpoint not covered by the other tools (see bridge_docs_search for paths). Irreversible endpoints need {"confirm": true} in the body. Confirm with the user before any call that sends, deletes or changes something.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bridge_get_started, bridge_list_templates, bridge_open_ticket, bridge_list_tickets · Public sink: bridge_get_started, bridge_docs_section, bridge_connect_link, bridge_send_text, bridge_send_template, bridge_failed_webhooks, bridge_retry_webhooks · Destructive: bridge_send_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bridge_get_started, bridge_list_templates, bridge_open_ticket, bridge_list_tickets · Public sink: bridge_get_started, bridge_docs_section, bridge_connect_link, bridge_send_text, bridge_send_template, bridge_failed_webhooks, bridge_retry_webhooks · Destructive: bridge_send_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
